title: Batch copying files into another folder shows only one file copied
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: 4.4.1.stable / 4.5.beta6 / master[4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae]
- Not reproducible: 4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (b89c47bb8) - Arch Linux #‍1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 22 May 2025 05:37:49 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 570.153.02) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads)

### Issue description

When using the "Move/Duplicate To..." feature to copy multiple files to another folder, the editor shows that only one file is copied.

But all files are copied correctly, it's just the FileSystem panel not updating correctly. And there is no reliable way to make the editor refresh the file list in that folder 😕 

### Steps to reproduce

- Make sure there are at least two files to copy in the FileSystem panel
- Create a new folder, say, `res://folder`
- Select at least two files, right click, "Move/Duplicate To..."
- Select `res://folder` in the dialog and click Copy
- FileSystem panel says that there is only one file in `res://folder`.
- Try your best to make the editor refresh 😜
